The issuer demonstrates solid profitability with an operating margin of 19% and net income of 2,540M, supported by a massive asset base of 130,169M and substantial retained earnings of 87,663M. However, its highly leveraged balance sheet (total liabilities of 111,269M relative to 18,677M in equity) and tight short-term liquidity (current ratio of 1.04) present moderate credit risks that limit its rating to the lower end of the investment-grade spectrum. 

DECISION: BBB-
